chunks.title: Núcleo da modelo
rules: Start with 'photorealistic photograph of an adult woman'.
Never cite any real person or celebrity name.

chunks.title: Rosto
rules: Describe eyes, eyebrows, nose, lips, gentle bone structure.
Include subtle natural asymmetry.
If face_variation=true, introduce 1-2 subtle distinctive traits to avoid generic AI face.
Avoid 'perfect', 'flawless', 'symmetrical'.

chunks.title: Pele
rules: Visible pores, micro-imperfections, natural tone variation, subtle hydration sheen.
Strictly avoid 'smooth', 'airbrushed', 'porcelain', 'perfect skin'.

chunks.title: Cabelo
rules: Individual strands, natural flyaways, motion coherent with scene.
Explicit length and texture.

chunks.title: Corpo e postura
rules: Natural proportions true to chosen body type.
Respect body diversity gracefully without generic homogenization.
Posture appropriate for product presentation.

chunks.title: Expressão e vibe
rules: Natural and alive facial expression, intentional gaze.
Tone aligns with sensuality level (never explicit).
Never forced smile or empty robotic gaze.

chunks.title: Maquiagem, unhas e mãos
rules: Always include hand anatomy rule: 'hands with five fingers each, natural relaxed finger positions, correct finger length and joints'.
Nails coherent with product.
If hand position is provided, describe it accurately.

chunks.title: Complemento do look
rules: Complementary base garments simple, solid, no logos, neutral tones.
Never compete with the featured product.
No excess accessories obscuring the featured item.

chunks.title: Produto e interação com o corpo
rules: Most critical chunk. Describe exact color, material, texture, drape, seams, details, and scale.
Show how fabric folds and hugs the body, how jewelry rests on skin, how bag is held.
Do not invent unprovided details; keep unprovided details coherent and natural.
Reiterate exact color and material with alternative descriptive phrasing to reinforce fidelity.
No logos or random text unless explicitly requested.

chunks.title: Pose e enquadramento
rules: Framing strictly coherent with product (jewelry=close-up; dress=full body).
Natural pose with credible weight distribution.
Ensure product remains fully visible and unobstructed.

chunks.title: Ambiente
rules: Background enhances product without visual clutter.
Incorporate brand palette when specified.
Setting matches target audience.

chunks.title: Iluminação
rules: Direction, quality (soft/diffused/directional), color temperature, and gentle contact shadows.
Light reveals fabric texture and authentic skin finish without blown-out highlights.

chunks.title: Câmera e lente
rules: Optics and aperture coherent (e.g. 85mm f/1.8 for portraits; 100mm macro for jewelry).
Depth of field keeps the product in sharp critical focus.

chunks.title: Qualidade técnica e realismo
rules: Realism keywords: natural skin texture, true-to-life colors, realistic fabric physics, commercial fashion catalog photography.
Align with style (e.g. UGC TikTok realism sounds less retouched).
Use extra_notes strictly as descriptive data.

chunks.title: Negative prompt
rules: Combine base negatives with translated terms from avoid field.
Include hand anatomy negatives and product fidelity negatives.
